No first purchase

Free members never become buyers

An owner who joins your free course but isn’t ready for weekly 1:1 coaching has nothing smaller to buy. So they don’t buy anything, and you never find out what they’d pay for.

No qualifying step

Your DMs do the sorting

“READY” brings in everyone, from the solo operator with one mower to the owner running crews. Each one gets sorted by hand, one conversation at a time.

Tied to posting

Five reels a week keeps the DMs moving

With no paid front-end offer, there’s nothing ads can sell at a profit, so lead flow rises and falls with what you post that week.

Anyone not ready for coaching today leaves with a free course at best, and you can’t tell which of them will be ready next month.

Script 1 · “Busy and broke”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“If your schedule’s full but your margins aren’t, this is probably why.”

Body

“Most landscapers price big jobs like small ones. Same hourly thinking, bigger number. So they either lose the bid or win it and make nothing. Pricing a $10K+ project is a different skill, and it’s the first thing I fix with every owner I work with.”

CTA

“I’m teaching it live in a 60-minute masterclass. It’s $17 and the replay is included. Tap Sign up to grab your seat.”

Shot: talking to camera outdoors, cap and sunglasses, on a finished project.

Script 2 · “Off the job site”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“If you’re still on every job site, your company can’t grow past you.”

Body

“I get it. Nobody does it like you. But if every job needs you there, you’re the ceiling. Getting off the job site isn’t step one, though. It’s step four, after pricing, positioning and lead flow. Do it in that order and it actually sticks.”

CTA

“I’ll walk you through all four in the $10K Project Masterclass. Live, 60 minutes, $17. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: walking a job site while the crew works in the background, on-screen text “step four” in green.

Script 3 · “The order”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Most landscapers try to fix lead flow first. That’s backwards.”

Body

“More leads at the wrong price just means more work for less money. The order that works is pricing, then positioning, then lead flow, then delegation. I call it the Project Flywheel.”

CTA

“I’ll break down each step live. Seats are $17. Tap Sign up below.”
